benefits.claim: The product provides a clear, shared view of who is doing what and by when, reducing the need for manual updates and inquiries.
Teams can increase efficiency by automating routine tasks and streamlining workflows, freeing up time for more impactful work.
Real-time data, reporting dashboards, and goal tracking enable better strategic decisions and progress monitoring.
